Measured across the audit landings: the gates caught ~30 errors — the
comment-ref ratchet refused 25 backticked names for things just deleted,
the drift-audit hook blocked a commit over one word, the census ratchets
refused four counts, the march refused two pins. The prose caught zero
that a gate did not. That is the ordering rule for every lesson after
it: a law that CAN become a gate must, and prose is for the ones that
cannot.

CsWideRow IS THAT RULE APPLIED TO THE MOST CONTESTABLE OPINION I HAD.
A signature declaring more than eight effects is an inventory, and the
objection is structural: SYNTAX says a declared row is "a CONSTRAINT
verified against the row inferred from the body", so every name is a
hand-copy of a computed fact, widening one leaf edits seven signatures,
and the one !E worth reading is buried in a list the author typed. The
wheel measured 132 signatures at four effects, 155 at five, then a tail
at 13, 14, 16, 17 (four), 18 and nineteen.

Bounded in src/board.mn, seen RED at 18 against its measured 19 — and it
FELL 19 -> 12 in the same landing. Seven of the nineteen were the same
sixteen-name core spelled seven times: the whole-program judgment's
capability, never named. `type Judging` names it, and those signatures
read `with Judging`, `+ Filesystem`, `+ Persist`, `+ Fail` — every
surviving name a decision. A row alias is transparent; no proven fact
moved.

METHOD, folded inside the laws each lesson sharpens rather than
appended: mechanism beats instruction, with the count and with the
uncomfortable half — the comments this audit refuted were written by
something that writes exactly the way these docs write, so fluency and
correctness are independent variables in its output. Legibility is an
error-detection mechanism, not hygiene: the SMT serializer was wrong for
as long as it had no caller and correct within an hour of getting one,
so dead-but-designed code is neither deleted nor left — it is given a
projection. And the kills belong in the lan

The open-row silent wrong went one hop deeper than the twin key. An
open-row callee reached from inside another twin's body read a neighbouring
field — 7 where 9 was asked — and the trace named a severed proof rather
than a bad unifier: the annotation closed row 24730 and the field access
read 24736, six cells later, with the offset unprovable in between.

Three writes close it, each the same law at a different site. free_in_ty's
TRecordOpen arm collected its row var unconditionally, so a bound row —
one already carrying a proven residual — was reported free, generalize
quantified it, and instantiate minted a fresh empty cell over the proof;
free_in_row states that exact rule six lines below and this sort had never
applied it. unify_two_open_records now unions two rows it has proven
identical, through the NBound(TVar) edge chase_handle already follows,
whose comment carries the law the arm was missing: unify unions the roots.
And absorb_into_residual stops writing an empty assumed residual onto cells
that know nothing — its bound arm already said do nothing, its unbound arm
said the opposite.

The fabrication had been paying a coin flip. mn-findtag passed because the
manufactured empty residual gave offset 0 and handle sorts first in
{handle, region_id}. Removing the guess trapped it, exactly as the code
comment warned it would, and the collector fix made it pass for the real
reason. That comment recorded the symptom and blessed the guess.

A third state became visible and the gate grew to see it: a remainder is
proven, assumed, or genuinely free, and the third was invisible while every
unknown cell got stamped assumed. tests/rows fixtures declare which they
expect on a residual header and all three readings are checked, where the
old gate asserted assumed and was gating a fabrication. Two fixtures were
re-derived by hand rather than re-banked; the interior repro graduates from
tests/repro-wf to the syntax battery.

Movers ceiling 470 to 471, the two collector fns.

two-top/99662bf:
Eight quiet chest marks (the eye, the cross, the anchor, the ring, the
slash, the fang, the gate, and the unmarked classic) baked into eight
sheet variants per side by the parametric builder. The rune paints only
over pixels that are already cloth, so the silhouette, the team hood,
and the eye heat are untouchable by construction — the silhouette gate
agrees, and the rune-0 sheets are byte-identical to the shipped
originals, proving the refactor inert for the base art. A module-level
active-rune global threads the choice through 41 frames x 3 views
instead of a parameter through every call; the generator is
single-threaded and deterministic, and the build sets and restores it.

Which mark a body wears derives from identity that already travels:
your install-id for your seat, the opponent's side-channel install-id
for theirs (the swap lands while the challenger is still hidden, so it
never pops), a never-your-own foil for the bot and couch P2, and the
header name for a tape's ghost. rune_for is pure and unit-tested; a
sync system swaps sprite sheets when the worn rune differs. Zero sim
surface, zero wire changes.

- Scene launch queuing: tapping a scene while playing queues it to snap
  in cleanly at the next bar boundary. Queued state shown as pulsing
  amber triangle/clip glow; clears immediately on stop.

- Auto-stop on visibility change: browser tab/app losing focus (e.g.
  phone notification) now calls audio.stop() so music doesn't leak
  into other apps.

- Session grid overhaul:
  - Scene long-press → Scene Options sheet (Launch, Duplicate, Move
    Up/Down, Delete)
  - '+ Scene' is now a permanent cell at the bottom of the scene column
  - Clip long-press → drag to reorder slots within a track column
  - Empty slots tappable to open editor directly
  - 'Delete Clip' button in Clip Options sheet to clear any slot
  - Editor sheet-bar gains an 'Options' button next to 'Done'

- Drum rack: pointer drag-paint across step cells to bulk add/delete
  notes in one gesture; drag mode set by initial cell state.

- '✨ Magic' footer button: generates a new harmonically correct scene
  (drums + chords + bass + melody all in current key/scale).

- clipContent now returns null for empty tracks so session grid
  correctly shows empty ('+') slots.

- applyProject: reset playingScene/playingTracks on load to avoid
  out-of-bounds visual state after loading a saved project.

- makeScene imported in main.js for Magic scene generation.
